held.title: Focus-return change not covered by the PR description.
held.body: This hunk changes which element gets focus back when the popup closes. If the element that had focus before opening (`elementFocusedBeforeOpen`) is inside `floating`, it is no longer used, and focus falls back to the reference element or `getPreviouslyFocusedElement()`. The PR description only covers how portal events reach React handlers and doesn't mention this. I couldn't confirm whether the new portal layout needs it (for example, because the effect now reruns while the popup is open). If it does, say so in the description and add a test for it. If it doesn't, move it to a separate PR.
